ideas.title: Following the Money Trail in the Feeding Our Future Scandal
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and connections behind the Feeding Our Future nonprofit to uncover potential shell companies and money laundering schemes
questions: What were the sources of funding for Feeding Our Future?
How did the nonprofit use its funds?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial transactions and connections behind Feeding Our Future, we may be able to uncover a larger scheme involving shell companies and money laundering
